ex: Havarti is a soft, mild cheese from Denmark.
Can I have a havarti sandwich, please?
Havarti melts well, so it is good for toast.
The store sells havarti with dill.
A bonang is a set of small gongs from Java.
The musician hits the bonang with two sticks.
The bonang plays the main melody in a gamelan.
Students can try the bonang at the music class.
Contango means future prices are higher than today's price.
Oil markets were in contango for most of the year.
In contango, storing the product can make money.
The report explains contango in simple words.
A hyperlapse is a fast video taken while moving.
She made a hyperlapse of her walk through the city.
Can your phone record a hyperlapse?
Hold the camera steady when you shoot a hyperlapse.
Isobutyl is a chemical group with four carbon atoms.
Isobutyl acetate smells a bit like fruit.
The paint thinner contains isobutyl alcohol.
Keep products with isobutyl away from fire.
Kashrut is the set of Jewish food laws.
Under kashrut, meat and milk are not eaten together.
The restaurant follows kashrut, so there is no pork.
A rabbi checks the kitchen for kashrut.
A langar is a free community kitchen at a Sikh temple.
Anyone can eat at the langar for free.
Volunteers cook rice and lentils for the langar.
We sat on the floor and ate at the langar.
Pickleball is like tennis on a smaller court.
Do you want to play pickleball after work?
You need a paddle and a plastic ball for pickleball.
The park has six new pickleball courts.
Rotoscoping means drawing over real video, frame by frame.
The music video used rotoscoping to look like a cartoon.
Rotoscoping takes many hours of careful work.
She learned rotoscoping in her animation course.
Yohimbine comes from the bark of an African tree.
Some fat-burning supplements contain yohimbine.
Yohimbine can raise your heart rate and blood pressure.
Ask your doctor before you take yohimbine.

mass spectroscope.note: "Mass spectrometer" is the more common term.

ex: Biltong is dried, salted meat from South Africa.
Can I buy some beef biltong for the trip?
Biltong is a good snack for long hikes.
The shop sells biltong in small bags.
Escherichia is a group of bacteria that includes E. coli.
Escherichia bacteria live in the human gut.
The water test found Escherichia, so we boiled our water.
Most Escherichia strains in the gut are harmless.
Siloxane is a compound of silicon and oxygen.
Many shampoos and creams contain siloxane.
Siloxane makes the sealant soft and waterproof.
The label lists a siloxane as the second ingredient.
A sympathomimetic is a drug that acts like adrenaline.
Many cold medicines contain a sympathomimetic for a stuffy nose.
A sympathomimetic can raise your blood pressure.
The doctor stopped the sympathomimetic because of his heart.
sympathomimetic.note: Often used as an adjective: "sympathomimetic drugs."

ex: An izakaya is a Japanese bar that serves small dishes.
Let's go to the izakaya after work.
We ordered grilled chicken and beer at the izakaya.
Is there a good izakaya near the station?
A fascinator is a small decorative hat with feathers.
She wore a blue fascinator to the wedding.
Can I wear a fascinator instead of a big hat?
The shop sells fascinators for the horse races.
Bupivacaine is a local anesthetic that numbs the body.
The dentist used bupivacaine because it lasts longer.
Bupivacaine was injected into her back before the birth.
The numbness from bupivacaine can last for hours.
Chillwave is calm electronic music with a dreamy sound.
I listen to chillwave when I work late.
The band plays chillwave with soft synths.
This chillwave playlist is great for a slow evening.
Dangdut is a popular kind of dance music from Indonesia.
The wedding band played dangdut all night.
Dangdut mixes Indian, Arabic, and Malay sounds.
My Indonesian friend taught me to dance to dangdut.
Dehydroepiandrosterone is a hormone made by the adrenal glands.
Dehydroepiandrosterone is usually called DHEA.
The blood test measured her dehydroepiandrosterone level.
Levels of dehydroepiandrosterone fall as people get older.
Fingerpicking means playing guitar strings with your fingers.
She uses fingerpicking for quiet folk songs.
Fingerpicking is hard for beginners at first.
Can you teach me some easy fingerpicking patterns?
A glycosyl group comes from a sugar molecule.
The enzyme moves a glycosyl group to a protein.
Glycosyl groups help cells recognize each other.
The lecture explained glycosyl transfer in simple steps.
Ijtihad means independent thinking in Islamic law.
Scholars use ijtihad when old texts give no clear answer.
The book discusses ijtihad in the modern world.
Some reformers want more ijtihad in religious education.
Medroxyprogesterone is a hormone used in birth control shots.
She gets a medroxyprogesterone injection every three months.
Medroxyprogesterone can also treat heavy periods.
The doctor explained the side effects of medroxyprogesterone.
Muscovado is dark brown sugar with a strong taste.
Use muscovado to make the cookies soft and rich.
Muscovado tastes a little like toffee.
Can I use muscovado instead of white sugar?
Shibori is a Japanese way of dyeing cloth.
She made a blue shibori scarf in the workshop.
In shibori, you fold and tie the fabric before dyeing.
The shop sells shibori pillow covers.
A silyl group contains a silicon atom.
Chemists use a silyl group to protect the molecule.
The reaction removes the silyl group at the end.
The paper describes a new silyl compound.
A singletrack is a narrow trail for one bike.
We rode the forest singletrack on our mountain bikes.
The singletrack is steep and full of roots.
Is this singletrack open to hikers too?
Tadalafil is a medicine for erectile problems.
Tadalafil can also help men with prostate problems.
Do not take tadalafil with nitrate heart pills.
The doctor explained how long tadalafil works.
Takfir means calling another Muslim an unbeliever.
Most Muslim scholars reject extreme takfir.
Extremist groups use takfir to justify violence.
The lecture explained the history of takfir.
Tokusatsu is Japanese film or TV with special effects.
Giant monster movies are a type of tokusatsu.
He watches tokusatsu shows with heroes in colorful suits.
Tokusatsu often uses actors in rubber monster costumes.
Vardenafil is a medicine for erectile problems.
Take vardenafil about an hour before you need it.
Vardenafil can cause headaches in some men.
Do not take vardenafil with nitrate heart pills.
A kriya is a yoga exercise for body and mind.
The teacher showed us a breathing kriya.
Do this kriya every morning for ten minutes.
Each kriya uses breath, movement, and sound.
Noisette means hazelnut in French cooking.
This chocolate has a soft noisette filling.
Cook the butter until it turns brown and noisette.
Can I have a café noisette with a little milk?
noisette.note: "Noisette" can also mean a small round piece of meat, like "lamb noisettes."

ex: Spinifex is a spiky grass that grows in Australian deserts.
The hills were covered in yellow spinifex.
Spinifex helps hold the sand in place.
Wear long pants because spinifex can scratch your legs.
Secco is painting on dry plaster.
The artist added the details in secco.
Secco paint can flake off the wall over time.
The church has frescoes and some secco work.
A babymoon is a trip before the baby is born.
We went to the sea for our babymoon.
Many hotels offer special babymoon packages.
Plan your babymoon before the last months of pregnancy.
Anandamide is a natural chemical in the brain.
Anandamide helps control mood and pain.
Exercise may raise anandamide levels in the body.
Scientists study anandamide to understand appetite.
Antifouling is a special paint for the bottom of boats.
We put new antifouling on the boat every spring.
Antifouling stops plants and shells from growing on the hull.
Some antifouling is harmful to sea life.

kraton.note: Usually spelled "craton." "Kraton" also means a palace in Java.

ex: A logline is a one-sentence summary of a movie.
Write a short logline for your script.
The producer liked the logline and asked for the script.
A good logline shows the hero and the problem.
A silicide is a compound of silicon and a metal.
Computer chips use metal silicide in their contacts.
Nickel silicide helps electricity flow well.
The engineers tested a new silicide layer.
Gabber is very fast and loud electronic dance music.
Gabber started in the Netherlands in the 1990s.
The club plays gabber on Friday nights.
Gabber fans often dance very fast.
gabber.note: Also informal: a person who talks a lot.

ex: A montgolfier is an old type of hot-air balloon.
The museum has a model of a montgolfier.
A montgolfier rises because hot air is lighter.
The festival ended with a flight of a paper montgolfier.
montgolfier.note: Most often "Montgolfier" is the name of the French brothers who made the first hot-air balloon.

ex: A havildar is a sergeant in the Indian army.
The havildar trained the young soldiers.
He was promoted to havildar after ten years.
The havildar checked the soldiers' uniforms.
A zarzuela is a Spanish light opera with songs and speech.
We saw a zarzuela at the theater in Madrid.
A zarzuela mixes singing, dancing, and comedy.
Her grandmother loves the music from old zarzuelas.
zarzuela.note: "Zarzuela" can also mean a Spanish seafood stew.

ex: An agaric is a mushroom with gills under the cap.
The red fly agaric is very poisonous.
Do not eat any agaric you cannot identify.
The book shows many kinds of agaric.
A tessera is a small piece of stone or glass in a mosaic.
Each tessera in the floor is a different color.
The artist glued every tessera by hand.
One gold tessera was missing from the old mosaic.
A countertenor is a man who sings very high.
The countertenor sang the role of the angel.
Countertenors often sing old church music.
Our choir needs a countertenor for this piece.

ahegao.note: Slang with a sexual meaning; avoid in formal situations.

ex: Diethylstilbestrol is a man-made form of estrogen.
Doctors once gave diethylstilbestrol to pregnant women.
Diethylstilbestrol is often called DES.
Diethylstilbestrol caused health problems in the children of these women.
A duiker is a small African antelope.
The duiker hides in thick bushes.
We saw a duiker on our safari.
A duiker eats leaves, fruit, and flowers.
An ephod is a special robe worn by priests in the Bible.
The high priest wore a golden ephod.
The ephod had two stones on the shoulders.
The story describes the ephod in detail.
The epigenome controls which genes are turned on or off.
Diet and stress can change the epigenome.
Scientists mapped the epigenome of blood cells.
Your epigenome changes as you get older.
Flexbox is a CSS tool for page layout.
Use flexbox to put the buttons in one row.
Flexbox makes it easy to center a box.
The menu breaks on phones, so check the flexbox settings.
